{{TOC|side}}

Owners of '''Digital Deluxe''', '''Extended''' and '''Supporter Edition''' of the game have all tracks accessible as MP3 files in the '''Bonus folder'''
(by default ''C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Arma 3\Bonus''). See also {{Link|Arma 3: Getting Started#Editions}} for a description of the currently-available editions.

{{Feature|informative|If you are looking for in-game music config, see [[Arma 3: CfgMusic]].}}
